relations.subject: search:object-mapping
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (watchlist predicate sharesOptionSetWith) - both mapping types offer the identical static/dynamic choice and can both host Child Field Mappings
relations.evidence: Like [Collection Mappings](#collections), object mappings can be [static](#static) or [dynamic](#dynamic). You can add [Child Field Mappings](#fields) to make an object mapping a static type mapping.

relations.subject: search:xattrs-mapping
relations.evidence: XATTRs mappings can be [static](#static) or [dynamic](#dynamic), based on whether you add [Child Field Mappings](#fields).

relations.subject: search:collection-mapping
relations.reused_or_minted_predicate: reused (usesEnum) - object concept minted in cloud/search/search-index-params.json; a type identifier's mode enum determines document-type filtering for a collection mapping
relations.evidence: You can also choose to control the type of a document by [setting a type identifier](set-type-identifier.md). A type identifier is an optional configuration that tells the Search Service how to interpret a document's type.

relations.subject: search:about-mappings
relations.evidence: For more information about how to create a type mapping, see [Create a New Mapping or Type Mapping](create-type-mapping.md).
